tasks.name: Cleanup E2B Dependencies Phase
tasks.description: Remove E2B cloud sandbox dependencies while preserving local functionality
tasks.testing_strategy: Unit tests for dependency removal, integration tests for local functionality preservation
tasks.notes: System already uses local sandbox manager, focus on removing lingering E2B imports and references

tasks.name: Remove E2B Package Dependencies
tasks.description: Remove E2B packages from package.json and update lock files
tasks.testing_strategy: Verify npm install works without E2B packages, run existing unit tests
tasks.notes: Search for @e2b-dev/* packages and remove. Update lockfile to ensure clean state

tasks.name: Remove E2B Import Statements
tasks.description: Find and remove all E2B imports from source files
tasks.testing_strategy: Static analysis to ensure no E2B imports remain, compile-time validation
tasks.notes: Use grep to find all E2B references, replace with local equivalents or remove dead code

tasks.name: Update API Routes for Local Operations
tasks.description: Modify API routes to use local sandbox manager instead of E2B client
tasks.testing_strategy: Integration tests for each API route using local sandbox manager
tasks.notes: Routes already use local functionality, clean up any remaining E2B client instantiation

tasks.name: Update Environment Configuration
tasks.description: Remove E2B environment variables and update configuration templates
tasks.testing_strategy: Verify application starts without E2B environment variables
tasks.notes: Remove E2B_API_KEY references, update documentation to reflect local-only operation

tasks.name: AI Provider Integration Consolidation Phase
tasks.description: Consolidate AI provider integration to Claude Code only
tasks.testing_strategy: End-to-end tests with Claude Code integration, model switching validation
tasks.notes: System already has Claude Code integration, remove other provider configurations

tasks.name: Update AI Model Configuration
tasks.description: Configure app.config.ts to use only Claude Code model
tasks.testing_strategy: Unit tests for configuration validation, integration tests for model selection
tasks.notes: Configuration already shows claude-code as default model, ensure UI elements reflect this

tasks.name: Remove Multi-Provider API Logic
tasks.description: Simplify code generation routes to use Claude Code exclusively
tasks.testing_strategy: Integration tests for code generation with Claude Code only
tasks.notes: Routes already use Claude Code integration, remove any provider selection logic

tasks.name: Update UI Components
tasks.description: Remove model selector and provider-specific UI elements
tasks.testing_strategy: UI tests to verify model selector is hidden, user experience validation
tasks.notes: Config already shows showModelSelector: false, verify UI implementation matches

tasks.name: Configuration and Dependencies Phase
tasks.description: Update configurations and dependencies for local-only operation
tasks.notes: Focus on optimizing existing local configurations

tasks.name: Optimize Local Sandbox Configuration
tasks.description: Review and optimize sandbox manager configuration for local-only operation
tasks.testing_strategy: Performance tests for sandbox operations, resource usage validation
tasks.notes: Configuration already optimized for local operations, review for any improvements

tasks.name: Update Documentation
tasks.description: Update README and documentation to reflect Claude Code-only setup
tasks.notes: Ensure all setup instructions reflect local-only operation with Claude Code

tasks.name: Clean Up Test Files
tasks.description: Remove or update tests that reference E2B or multiple AI providers
tasks.testing_strategy: Test suite validation, ensure all tests pass with local-only setup
tasks.notes: Update integration tests to use local sandbox manager, remove E2B-specific tests

tasks.name: Testing and Validation Phase
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing of local Claude Code-only implementation
tasks.testing_strategy: Full test suite execution, user acceptance testing, performance validation
tasks.notes: Validate that all existing functionality works with local-only setup

tasks.name: Run Unit Test Suite
tasks.description: Execute all unit tests to ensure local functionality works correctly
tasks.testing_strategy: npm run test:unit with coverage analysis
tasks.notes: Focus on sandbox manager, file operations, and configuration validation

tasks.name: Run Integration Tests
tasks.description: Execute integration tests for API routes and sandbox operations
tasks.testing_strategy: npm run test:integration focusing on local sandbox workflows
tasks.notes: Validate end-to-end code generation and application workflows

tasks.name: Performance Testing
tasks.description: Validate performance of local-only operations meets requirements
tasks.testing_strategy: Performance benchmarks for code generation and sandbox operations
tasks.notes: Ensure local operations are fast and responsive, measure resource usage

tasks.name: User Acceptance Testing
tasks.description: End-to-end validation of user workflows with Claude Code-only setup
tasks.testing_strategy: Manual testing of key user journeys: code generation, editing, package management
tasks.notes: Validate complete user experience matches expectations for local development
